detailed_family.title: SEA-PATHFINDER SPF-100
details: Sensor / platform: Depth/pressure and temperature sensors | Water resistance: 200 m ISO-compliant | Power: CR2025, approx. 2 years (comparison
graphic only) | Synchronization: Not stated
Functions and specifications: Dive data auto-start at 1.0 m; 20 dive logs; per-minute dive profile up to 100 minutes; nitrogen-tissue graphs with 9
half-times; surface interval up to 48 hours; temperature -10 to 60 C, 0.1 C steps; EL auto light; EEPROM nonvolatile dive data; time alarm and hourly
signal. The archived Casio page specifies depth measuring range 0-80 m, 0.1-m steps.
Dimensions: Approx. 47.1 x 52.0 x 14.1 mm (comparison graphic only). Notes: Conflict: supplied image gives 0-60 m measurement range. The archived
Casio page explicitly says 0-80 m. Do not treat the image-to-module correspondence as independently verified.
Source: SPF-ARCHIVE p1; supplied SPF image.

cells: 0-60.0 m claimed in graphic: CONFLICT; archive states 80.0 m.

-10 to 60 C; display steps of 0.1 C
EL backlight; auto-light tilt about 40 degrees

graphic only) | Synchronization: Not stated
Functions and specifications: Dive data auto-start at 1.0 m; 20 dive logs; per-minute dive profile up to 100 minutes; nitrogen-tissue graphs with 9
half-times; surface interval up to 48 hours; temperature -10 to 60 C, 0.1 C steps; EL auto light; EEPROM nonvolatile dive data; time alarm and hourly
signal. The archived Casio page specifies depth measuring range 0-80 m, 0.1-m steps.
